<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" xmlns:xsd="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema" id="Definitions_RobotBurgerSeller" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/robot-burger-seller">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_RobotBurgerSeller" name="Robotic Burger Seller near the University of Vienna" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" name="Order placed">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_ReceiveOrder" name="Receive order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" name="Ask whether customer wants a menu or just the burger">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MenuChoice_Split" name="Menu or burger only?" default="Flow_BurgerOnly">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Menu</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_BurgerOnly</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Menu_Fork" name="Start menu preparation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Menu</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareDrink" name="Prepare drink">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the drink size.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" name="Ask whether customer wants fries or wedges">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Menu_Join" name="Drink and side choice done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Side_Split" name="Fries or wedges?" default="Flow_Wedges">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Fries</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wedges</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareFries" name="Prepare fries">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the fries portion size.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Fries</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareWedges" name="Prepare wedges">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the wedges portion size.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wedges</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Side_Merge" name="Side prepared">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Burger_Merge" name="Ready to prepare burger">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_BurgerOnly</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_PrepareBurger" name="Prepare burger">
      <bpmn:documentation>Duration varies depending on the number of ingredients. The robot gives enthusiastic status updates every 30 seconds while preparing.</bpmn:documentation>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:boundaryEvent id="BoundaryEvent_StatusUpdateTimer" name="Every 30 seconds" attachedToRef="Task_PrepareBurger" cancelActivity="false">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_StatusUpdate">
        <bpmn:timeCycle xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">R/PT30S</bpmn:timeCycle>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:boundaryEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_GiveStatusUpdate" name="Give enthusiastic status update to customer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_StatusUpdateSent" name="Status update sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DeliverOrder" name="Deliver order via conveyor belt">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderDelivered" name="Order delivered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_OrderPlaced" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOrder" targetRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_AskMenuOrBurger" targetRef="Gateway_MenuChoice_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Menu" name="Menu" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Menu_Fork">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${wantsMenu}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_BurgerOnly" name="Just the burger" sourceRef="Gateway_MenuChoice_Split" targetRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Gateway_Menu_Fork" targetRef="Task_PrepareDrink"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Menu_Fork" targetRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" sourceRef="Task_PrepareDrink" targetRef="Gateway_Menu_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" sourceRef="Task_AskFriesOrWedges" targetRef="Gateway_Menu_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Gateway_Menu_Join" targetRef="Gateway_Side_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Fries" name="Fries" sourceRef="Gateway_Side_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareFries">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${friesChosen}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wedges" name="Wedges" sourceRef="Gateway_Side_Split" targetRef="Task_PrepareWedges"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_PrepareFries" targetRef="Gateway_Side_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_PrepareWedges" targetRef="Gateway_Side_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Gateway_Side_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_Burger_Merge" targetRef="Task_PrepareBurger"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_PrepareBurger" targetRef="Task_DeliverOrder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="BoundaryEvent_StatusUpdateTimer" targetRef="Task_GiveStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Task_GiveStatusUpdate" targetRef="EndEvent_StatusUpdateSent"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="Task_DeliverOrder" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderDelivered"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
